title.en: Restore the visible Free Trial course entry
title.zh: 恢复清晰可见的课程免费试学入口

purpose.en: Make the anonymous Beginner Free Trial clearly visible beside Free to Play on every language course detail page and verify the complete production entry flow.
purpose.zh: 让每个语言课程详情页的匿名初级免费试学按钮清晰显示在免费游戏右侧，并验证完整生产入口流程。

en: Restore the missing dark SmartLingo hero shell on every localized language course detail page.
Render Free Trial immediately to the right of Free to Play with a visible high-contrast outline.
Preserve the target language in the anonymous Beginner trial URL and expose all five trial learning skills.
Keep anonymous trial activity in page memory without account or database writes.
zh: 恢复所有本地化语言课程详情页缺失的 SmartLingo 深色 Hero 外壳。
把免费试学紧邻免费游戏右侧显示，并提供清晰的高对比度描边。
在匿名初级试学 URL 中保留目标语言，并提供全部五项试学技能。
匿名试学操作仅保存在当前页面内存，不写入账户或数据库。

en: Chinese and English language course detail routes
Anonymous Beginner trial routes for all twelve target languages
Project release history for this production fix
zh: 中英文界面的语言课程详情路由
十二种目标语言的匿名初级试学路由
本次生产修复的项目发布历史

en: Wrap the shared header and course hero in the existing SmartLingo dark hero surface.
Use the shared responsive action row so all three course actions remain visible and wrap safely.
Add regression checks for the hero shell, action row, trial link, and no-persistence contract.
zh: 用现有 SmartLingo 深色 Hero 表面包裹共享页头和课程 Hero。
采用共享响应式操作栏，确保三个课程操作都清晰可见并安全换行。
增加 Hero 外壳、操作栏、试学链接和不持久化约束的回归检查。

en: All 297 automated site tests, TypeScript checks, lint, production build, artifact validation, and sensitive-data scan
Phone, iPad portrait, iPad landscape, and desktop responsive visibility and overflow checks
Production Safari and Chrome checks of button visibility, right-side placement, target-language URL, and five-skill anonymous trial
zh: 全部 297 项自动化测试、TypeScript、Lint、生产构建、产物校验和敏感信息扫描
手机、iPad 竖屏、iPad 横屏和桌面端的按钮可见性及溢出检查
使用生产 Safari 与 Chrome 验证按钮可见、右侧位置、目标语言 URL 和五项匿名试学

en: Signed-in subscription and realtime classroom flows were intentionally unchanged and were not rerun for this public anonymous-entry UI fix.
zh: 本次仅修复公开匿名入口 UI，未改动登录订阅与实时课堂流程，因此未重新执行这些流程。

en: Keep smartlingo.net data, identity, deployment credentials, production resources, and anonymous no-write behavior isolated.
zh: 保持 smartlingo.net 的数据、身份系统、部署凭据、生产资源及匿名不写库行为完全独立。
